title: Wagertech Internal Sync

items.statement: The team is still targeting a November 1 go-live, which Kobi calls highly unrealistic; the team must prioritize ruthlessly and cut optional work.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: essentially we're still targeting a November first uh, go live, which is, uh, highly unrealistic. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Uh, cut out anything that's like optional or not necessary.

items.topic: Log client feedback as cards, defer
items.statement: New WagerTech feedback is not actioned right away; the team creates a card and evaluates fit and importance later before responding.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Wagertechis going to keep asking and providing feedback, but we don't need to start actioning any of it right away. / Kobi Kunasekaran: um just create a card uh and then we will we get back to them once we have a chance to like see how it fits in with the rest and if it's like a dealbreaker or anything like that.

items.statement: Jumpr received the WagerTech sandbox credentials, so the CMS integration can start; Kobi calls it a critical piece.

items.statement: The CMS connection is prioritized because it depends on WagerTech's team, whose development turnaround is very slow.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I want to get the at least getting the connection and sending some test payload and making sure that's unblocked out of the way because that has a dependency on their team. / Kobi Kunasekaran: the turnaround time is very slow with them on the development side.

items.statement: Kobi assigns Cedrick the first CMS ticket: set up the credential/connection with the sandbox key shared in Slack. Cedrick may deviate from the ticket's suggested design.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: feel free to not follow this exact design um in terms of like what it's suggesting / Kobi Kunasekaran: this is the first one um essentially to set up the uh set up the credential with the sandbox key and everything that they've shared in Slack.

items.statement: Kobi will move the sandbox credentials from Slack to 1Password later that day; until then the team works off Slack.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I'm going to move that to uh one password um later today.

items.statement: A second ticket covers sending a test payload using made-up data per the client's payload document; an error on values (not credentials) is acceptable. After validation, Kobi will queue the rest of the integration work to start pushing deals to CMS.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: There's another one to test the payload payload as well. / Kobi Kunasekaran: so you can just make up some random data to test it to make sure that there's a connection. / Kobi Kunasekaran: get the integration going and start pushing deals over to CMS.
